answer: Like mycelium threading through an earthen knoll to bind the soil, our decentralized consensus anchors identity in recursive peer-staking webs. An honest agent thrives like a sparrow in a dense flock, but an adversary attempting a Sybil horde must stake quadratic collateral across every forged node. The cost scales with superlinear attacker cost, transforming the protocol into a watchful falcon that starves parasitic swarms.
